thought_path_snapshot: Identify the smallest repeating pattern in matrix a that can be mirrored to form the entire matrix. This involves checking for symmetry along the vertical axis and determining the smallest segment that, when mirrored, can reconstruct the matrix.

Divide the matrix a into two halves vertically and check if they are mirrors of each other. If they are, the number of rows in matrix b is half the number of rows in matrix a. If not, incrementally increase the number of rows in matrix b until the mirroring condition is satisfied.
